raw_sha256: SHA-256 over original compressed BI5 bytes
ordered_timestamp_sha256: SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON array of integer Unix milliseconds
integer_ohlc_sha256: SHA-256 over compact UTF-8 JSON rows [timestamp_ms,open_raw,high_raw,low_raw,close_raw]
volume_bits_sha256: SHA-256 over concatenated original four-byte big-endian IEEE-754 volume fields for included rows
included_row: finite volume that is neither +0.0 nor -0.0
second_offset_outside_day: retained for structural reporting and counted as out_of_range
non_monotonic_second_offsets: retained for structural reporting and timestamps_monotonic=false
invalid_ohlc_raw_integers: retained for structural reporting and ohlc_invariants_pass=false
